name: ARTePorto Art Fair
description: Porto's first large-scale art-market fair in three decades, bringing contemporary, modern, and antique treasures to the historic waterfront.
longDescription:
The ARTePorto Art Fair, taking place from September 24th to September 27th, 2026, marks the first significant art market event of its kind in Porto in thirty years. Organized by a consortium of local art dealers and cultural institutions, the fair aims to establish a regular platform for art acquisition and appreciation in the city. It will feature a diverse selection of artworks spanning contemporary, modern, and antique periods, presented by galleries and individual exhibitors.

Visitors to ARTePorto will encounter a wide array of artistic expressions within the grand setting of Alfândega do Porto, a historic building on the city's waterfront. The fair is designed for art collectors, enthusiasts, and the general public, offering an opportunity to view and purchase art across various price points. The atmosphere is expected to be focused on discovery and engagement with the presented works.

Admission to ARTePorto will vary in price. The Alfândega do Porto is accessible via bus lines 500 and 901, with stops directly outside the venue. It is also a walkable distance from the historic Ribeira district. Specific details regarding accessibility will be provided closer to the event date.
